description: A hit's remake for the AI video model an agent holds: keep, per-model prompts, the check. `video_id` or `url` of a hit, or `format_id` (its reference hit): `recipe` is `shorti.remake_recipe.v1`, the hit's own clock (cuts, beats, hook, turn) written as AI video models take it, for the creator's own generation tool (a Higgsfield, fal or gateway MCP). `mode`: swap_person (the creator in the hit's own shot), swap_place, swap_product, restyle_3d (a 3D animated version), character (every performer becomes one character), episode (a new episode of an AI-made format). `prompts` holds one plan per model — Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3, Kling 3.0 Motion Control, Wan 3.0 — with its references in order and what each needs prepared, its requests cut at the hit's own cuts inside the model's limits (each with a timestamped prompt and parameters) and its list price; then `keep`, `fit`, `steps`, the `sound` to post with and the `check` the result goes back to. Nothing here generates or spends. What the hit did, never why it spread; not a forecast of views. The default summary keeps the source clock, keep, links and each model's segment_count and first request (for_model=true). Read detail='full' for all requests: it preserves the unchanged legacy answer.

detail.description: summary: compact agent answer, Korean person-facing text with lang=ko; model prompts are marked for_model=true. full: the unchanged legacy answer, including its original bilingual/model text.

lang.description: The creator's language. 'en' answers in the English Shorti wrote: never translate its Korean yourself.

url.description: The hit, by the post's link.
